messages:
Marco L: hi all, i'm Marco (joined yesterday) and prepping to validate the payment-experiments rollout in staging. who do i ask for console + feature-flag admin in staging? also curious about prod-readonly if needed later :wave:
DevOps-Carol: welcome Marco! i'll give you `ff-admin-staging` for toggles and `console-readonly-prod` for viewing prod configs. staging admin is immediate, prod-readonly requires the access request form + manager OK.
Marco L: thanks Carol. any docs on safe toggles? i don't want to accidentally impact metrics or canaries
Evan T: hi Marco — quick checklist we use:
- always run the dry-run in staging first (Console > Feature Flags > Preview)
- annotate the change in the rollout ticket with expected metric delta
- if flipping in prod, request a change window and 2 approvers (owner + product)
Also, avoid flipping >10% of traffic without a canary and monitoring.
Marco L: good call. who owns the `payment-experiments` flag? want to coordinate the experiment window
Mat S: @Marco L that's me (product). ping me the experiment spec and I'll do signoff. for small staging tests you can proceed after notifying me here.
Marco L: perfect, i'll draft the spec. Carol, how long does the staging admin last?
DevOps-Carol: i'll provision a 48h role by default for new hires. command I run:

```
rbac grant --user marco.l --role ff-admin-staging --duration 48h --notes "new-hire onboarding"
```

DevOps-Carol: once you have access, toggles are under Console > Feature Flags > [flag] > Override. we also have an API if you prefer automation:
```
PATCH https://console.api.redwood/v1/flags/payment-experiments
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{
  "env": "staging",
  "override": { "perc": 50 }
}
```
ProductOps-Bot: Reminder: Prod flag changes must include a change ticket link and two approvers. See https://internal.redwood/access/flags-policy
Marco L: noted. Mat, i'll add you to the ticket. Carol, can you add me to the staging-observability team so i can see canary dashboards?
DevOps-Carol: done — you should have access in ~2 minutes. infra log:
ProductOps-Bot: Access event: grant user=marco.l role=ff-admin-staging expires=177208... actor=devops-carol
Marco L: got access and can see the dashboards. thanks everyone, i'll post the experiment spec here shortly and request a quick pairing if anyone is free to watch the first toggle :thumbsup:
Evan T: happy to pair after lunch — ping me and i'll join the call/zoom for the first flip
Mat S: i'll be on standby for the signoff. welcome again Marco! :tada:
